Scope:
class ara::crypto::TrustedContainer
Syntax:
virtual ContentType GetObjectId (CryptoObjectUid *objectUid=nullptr)
const noexcept=0;
Parameters (out):
objectUid
the optional pointer to buffer for getting COUID of an
object stored in the container
Return value:
ContentType
type of the content stored in the container
Exception Safety:
noexcept
Thread Safety:
Thread-safe
Header file:
#include "ara/crypto/common/trusted_container.h"
Description:
Return COUID and type of an object stored to this trusted container.
Notes:
If the container is empty then this method returns ContentType::kNone.
If (objectUid != nullptr), but the container is empty then the objectUid will be filled by all zeros.
Unambiguous identification of a crypto object requires both components: CryptoObjectUid and
ContentType.
A caller code may omit the optional argument if only the content type is interested.
